SBI 1844 Missing Statements (8-5-2022 |.query:
SELECT
date AS "Date",
sbi_1844_ib AS "SBI | 1844 | Initial Balance",
sbi_1844_d AS "SBI | 1844 | Debit",
sbi_1844_c AS "SBI | 1844 | Credit",
sbi_1844_fb AS "SBI | 1844 | Final Balance",
sbi_1844_sts AS "SBI | 1844 | Statements"
FROM (
SELECT * FROM dcb_with_statements_2022
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM dcb_with_statements_2023_unbound
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM dcb_with_statements_2024_unbound
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM dcb_with_statements_2025_unbound
) AS all_years
WHERE
(((sbi_1844_d IS NOT NULL) OR (sbi_1844_c IS NOT NULL))
AND (sbi_1844_sts IS NULL))
AND (date != 'TOTAL:')

Smart Meter Summary (1-8-2024 | 4-23-20.query:
SELECT 
"From => 01-08-2024 : To => 12-31-2024" AS Year ,
ROUND (AVG (unit_day), 2) AS Unit_Per_Day ,
SUM (rcg) AS Total_Recharge ,
ROUND (AVG (rcg), 2) AS Average_Charge_Per_Day
FROM smart_meter_2024 
WHERE date != "Jan 1 to 7 2024"
UNION ALL 
SELECT 
"From => 01-01-2025 : To => 12-31-2025" AS year ,
ROUND (AVG (unit_day), 2) AS Unit_Per_Day ,
SUM (rcg) AS Total_Recharge ,
ROUND (AVG (rcg), 2) AS Average_Charge_Per_Day
FROM smart_meter_2025
UNION ALL 
SELECT 
"From => 01-01-2026 : To => 04-23-2026" AS Year,
ROUND (AVG (unit_day), 2) AS Unit_Per_Day ,
SUM (rcg) AS Total_Recharge ,
ROUND (AVG (rcg), 2) AS Average_Charge_Per_Day 
FROM smart_meter_2026 
WHERE date (SUBSTR (date , 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR (date, 1, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR (date , 4, 2)) <= date('2026-04-23')

2022 Monthly Summed Debit & Credit (MSD.query:
SELECT
"2022" AS Year ,
CASE SUBSTR(date, 1, INSTR(date, '/') - 1)
WHEN '1'  THEN 'January'
WHEN '2'  THEN 'February'
WHEN '3'  THEN 'March'
WHEN '4'  THEN 'April'
WHEN '5'  THEN 'May'
WHEN '6'  THEN 'June'
WHEN '7'  THEN 'July'
WHEN '8'  THEN 'August'
WHEN '9'  THEN 'September'
WHEN '10' THEN 'October'
WHEN '11' THEN 'November'
WHEN '12' THEN 'December'
END AS Month ,
ROUND (SUM (CAST (sbi_1844_d AS REAL)), 2) AS "SBI 1844 MSD" ,
ROUND (SUM (CAST (sbi_1844_c AS REAL)), 2) AS "SBI 1844 MSC" ,
ROUND (SUM (CAST (sbi_7053_d AS REAL)), 2) AS "SBI 7053 MSD" ,
ROUND (SUM (CAST (sbi_7053_c AS REAL)), 2) AS "SBI 7053 MSC" ,
ROUND (SUM (CAST (fed_8433_d AS REAL)), 2) AS "FED 8433 MSD" ,
ROUND (SUM (CAST (fed_8433_c AS REAL)), 2) AS "FED 8433 MSC" 
FROM dcb_with_statements_2022 
WHERE date != "TOTAL:"
GROUP BY
SUBSTR(date, 1, INSTR(date, '/') - 1)
ORDER BY
CASE SUBSTR(date, 1, INSTR(date, '/') - 1)
WHEN '1' THEN 1
WHEN '2' THEN 2
WHEN '3' THEN 3
WHEN '4' THEN 4
WHEN '5' THEN 5
WHEN '6' THEN 6
WHEN '7' THEN 7
WHEN '8' THEN 8
WHEN '9' THEN 9
WHEN '10' THEN 10
WHEN '11' THEN 11
WHEN '12' THEN 12
END
